## Install

From an AirStack checkout ([AirStack Modules guide](../development/modules.md)):

```bash
airstack module add https://github.com/castacks/asm_droan --version v0.1.0
airstack up
```

`module add` pins the module in `modules.repos` and syncs it into the
gitignored `modules/` overlay; `airstack up` automatically includes the
generated compose override that mounts it into the containers.

## Registry notes

> Public repo. AirStack's in-tree local planner through 0.20.x, extracted with git filter-repo (history preserved) when MIGHTY became the default local planner in 0.21.0-dev.11 (compat floor dev.10 is one catalog-only sync earlier); older trunks still carry these packages in-tree, hence the compat floor. The droan_gl link deps (assimp / EGL / GLFW / GLM) are declared as tier-1 apt deps and enter the robot image via `airstack module lock --build` (run by `airstack up` when missing). Pick DROAN for depth-camera-only vehicles or minimal compute; the judged comparison that motivated the MIGHTY default is in the asm_mighty README. Consumed by trunk reference stacks full_droan (GPU), full_droan_cpu (CPU) and full_macvo (GPU, MAC-VO disparity source).
